//ConnectionStrings: NO CONNECTION STRING IS COMMITTED. Development supplies ConnectionStrings:KellumsDatabase through User Secrets and must target KSC-Dev. Production supplies ConnectionStrings__KellumsDatabase through IIS/environment configuration and must target KSC-Prod.

Business.//: FALLBACKS ONLY. Confirmed values are populated here; the admin console at /admin/site-settings writes to the SiteSettings table, which takes precedence. Unconfirmed empty values are hidden on the public site.
Business.Tagline: Your home deserves a second chance.

AntiSpam.//IpHashSalt: MUST be overridden per environment via AntiSpam__IpHashSalt. The default in code is only adequate for local development.

MediaStorage.//RootPath: Where uploaded project photographs are written. Empty means <content root>/wwwroot/uploads. POINT THIS AT A PATH OUTSIDE THE DEPLOYMENT FOLDER if you want photographs to survive a redeploy - e.g. D:/home/kellums-media on Azure App Service, or /var/lib/kellums/media on Linux.
MediaStorage.//PublicPathPrefix: URL prefix the media root is served from. Must match nothing else in the app.
MediaStorage.//MaxUploadMegabytes: Per-file ceiling. The endpoint's own request limit sits slightly above this so an oversized file is refused with a clear message rather than a connection reset.

EmailNotifications.//: Resend delivery is disabled by default. Supply ResendApiKey only through User Secrets or the deployment environment.
EmailNotifications.//AdminBaseUrl: Absolute origin used to build the deep link into the console, e.g. https://www.example.com. Falls back to the request's own origin.

Seed.//: Seeding only inserts into empty tables and NEVER applies migrations. AdminPassword must come from user secrets or an environment variable (Seed__AdminPassword) - never from this file.
